value.assessment: The core workflows are sound; access control is underspecified.

gaps.description: NFR-01 names no roles or permission model.
gaps.recommendation: Define roles before the architecture is designed.

risks.description: Clinical data handling may require regional certification.
risks.mitigation: Confirm the applicable regime before go-live.

value.reasoning: FR-01 and FR-02 are specific and testable. NFR-01 names no roles and no permission model, so two engineers would implement it differently — I questioned it rather than letting the architect guess. The regulatory exposure follows from the domain and belongs on the risk register.
